//go:build integration
// +build integration

package integration

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestCourseFilters(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	tests := []struct {
		name           string
		path           string
		query          string
		expectedStatus int
		checkResponse  func(*testing.T, *httptest.ResponseRecorder)
	}{
		{
			name:           "list courses without filters",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
			checkResponse: func(t *testing.T, resp *httptest.ResponseRecorder) {
				var result map[string]interface{}
				if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &result); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("failed to parse response: %v", err)
				}
				if _, ok := result["courses"]; !ok {
					t.Error("response should contain 'courses' key")
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name:           "filter courses by slug",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "slug=existing-course",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
			checkResponse: func(t *testing.T, resp *httptest.ResponseRecorder) {
				var result map[string]interface{}
				if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &result); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("failed to parse response: %v", err)
				}
				courses, ok := result["courses"].([]interface{})
				if !ok {
					t.Fatal("courses should be an array")
				}
				// Repository should filter by slug
				// Note: This depends on fake repository implementation
				_ = courses
			},
		},
		{
			name:           "filter courses by invalid uuid",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "id=not-a-uuid",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusBadRequest,
		},
		{
			name:           "filter courses by valid uuid",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          fmt.Sprintf("id=%s", fixtures.courseID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "filter courses by status",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "status=1",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "filter courses by negative status",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "status=-1",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusBadRequest,
		},
		{
			name:           "filter courses by title",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "title=Course",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "filter courses with multiple filters",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          fmt.Sprintf("id=%s&status=1&title=Course", fixtures.courseID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			url := tt.path
			if tt.query != "" {
				url += "?" + tt.query
			}

			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, url, nil)
			req.Header.Set("Accept-Language", "en")
			resp := httptest.NewRecorder()

			fixtures.router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

			if resp.Code != tt.expectedStatus {
				t.Errorf("expected status %d, got %d. Body: %s", tt.expectedStatus, resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
			}

			if tt.checkResponse != nil && resp.Code == http.StatusOK {
				tt.checkResponse(t, resp)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCourseSorting(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	tests := []struct {
		name           string
		path           string
		query          string
		expectedStatus int
	}{
		{
			name:           "sort courses by created_at asc",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "sort=created_at&order=asc",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "sort courses by created_at desc",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "sort=created_at&order=desc",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "sort courses by updated_at",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "sort=updated_at&order=desc",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "sort courses by title",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "sort=title&order=asc",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "sort with invalid field",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "sort=invalid_field&order=asc",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK, // Invalid sort is ignored, returns default
		},
		{
			name:           "sort without order defaults to asc",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          "sort=created_at",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "sort and filter combined",
			path:           "/api/v1/course/list",
			query:          fmt.Sprintf("id=%s&sort=created_at&order=desc", fixtures.courseID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			url := tt.path + "?" + tt.query

			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, url, nil)
			req.Header.Set("Accept-Language", "en")
			resp := httptest.NewRecorder()

			fixtures.router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

			if resp.Code != tt.expectedStatus {
				t.Errorf("expected status %d, got %d. Body: %s", tt.expectedStatus, resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestLessonFilters(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	tests := []struct {
		name           string
		path           string
		query          string
		expectedStatus int
	}{
		{
			name:           "filter lessons by course_id",
			path:           "/api/v1/lesson/list",
			query:          fmt.Sprintf("course_id=%s", fixtures.courseID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "filter lessons by invalid uuid",
			path:           "/api/v1/lesson/list",
			query:          "course_id=not-a-uuid",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusBadRequest,
		},
		{
			name:           "filter lessons by title",
			path:           "/api/v1/lesson/list",
			query:          fmt.Sprintf("course_id=%s&title=Lesson", fixtures.courseID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "filter lessons by status",
			path:           "/api/v1/lesson/list",
			query:          fmt.Sprintf("course_id=%s&status=1", fixtures.courseID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			url := tt.path + "?" + tt.query

			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, url, nil)
			req.Header.Set("Accept-Language", "en")
			resp := httptest.NewRecorder()

			fixtures.router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

			if resp.Code != tt.expectedStatus {
				t.Errorf("expected status %d, got %d. Body: %s", tt.expectedStatus, resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

}

func TestAdminFiltersAndSort(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	tests := []struct {
		name           string
		path           string
		query          string
		role           string
		expectedStatus int
	}{
		{
			name:           "admin list courses with filters",
			path:           "/course/list",
			query:          fmt.Sprintf("id=%s&status=1", fixtures.courseID),
			role:           "ADMIN",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "admin list courses with sort",
			path:           "/course/list",
			query:          "sort=created_at&order=desc",
			role:           "ADMIN",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "admin list lessons with filters",
			path:           "/lesson/list",
			query:          fmt.Sprintf("course_id=%s", fixtures.courseID),
			role:           "ADMIN",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name:           "admin list tasks with filters",
			path:           "/task/list",
			query:          fmt.Sprintf("lesson_id=%s", fixtures.lessonID),
			role:           "ADMIN",
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			url := tt.path + "?" + tt.query

			resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, url, "", tt.role, "test-user")

			if resp.Code != tt.expectedStatus {
				t.Errorf("expected status %d, got %d. Body: %s", tt.expectedStatus, resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}
